paper_title: Rethinking the Role of Prompting Strategies in LLM Test-Time Scaling A   Perspective of Probability Theory
caption: Results of combining adaptively scaling and dynamically choosing the optimal i on Gemini-1.5-Flash on MATH.

model_annotations.Bulgarian:
The chart illustrates the accuracy of various prompting strategies as a function of sampling time, measured in steps from 0 to 25. The vertical axis, labeled "Accuracy," ranges from 74 to 90, with tick marks and labels at intervals of 2 units. The horizontal axis, labeled "Sampling Time," spans from 0 to 25, with integer tick marks at each whole number. The chart contains six distinct lines, each representing a different prompting strategy, as identified by the legend.

The first line, labeled "DiP," is represented by a purple line with triangle markers. It begins at an accuracy of approximately 78.2 at sampling time 0, rises to a peak of approximately 82.4 at sampling time 5, then fluctuates slightly before stabilizing around 81.8 to 82.2 from sampling time 10 to 25.

The second line, labeled "AnP," is represented by an orange line with triangle markers. It starts at an accuracy of approximately 74.0 at sampling time 0, increases to a peak of approximately 79.2 at sampling time 5, then exhibits minor fluctuations, remaining mostly between 78.0 and 80.0 for the remainder of the sampling time range.

The third line, labeled "CoT," is represented by a blue line with triangle markers. It begins at an accuracy of approximately 80.0 at sampling time 0, rises steadily to a peak of approximately 83.8 at sampling time 10, then slightly declines to approximately 83.2 at sampling time 25.

The fourth line, labeled "Dynamic w/ Oracle," is represented by a black dashed line with square markers. It starts at an accuracy of approximately 88.4 at sampling time 0, declines slightly to approximately 87.0 at sampling time 5, then fluctuates between approximately 86.4 and 87.6 until sampling time 25.

The fifth line, labeled "L2M," is represented by a cyan line with triangle markers. It begins at an accuracy of approximately 77.0 at sampling time 0, increases steadily to a peak of approximately 81.8 at sampling time 10, then slightly declines to approximately 81.0 at sampling time 25.

The sixth line, labeled "Adaptive + Dynamic w/ Oracle," is represented by a red dashed line with circular markers. It starts at an accuracy of approximately 88.4 at sampling time 0, remains nearly constant at approximately 89.0 from sampling time 5 to 25.
model_annotations.German: This line chart displays the accuracy of various prompting strategies over increasing sampling time on the MATH benchmark, with accuracy measured on the y-axis ranging from 74 to 90 and sampling time on the x-axis ranging from 0 to 25. The x-axis is linearly scaled with integer tick marks at intervals of 5. The y-axis is also linearly scaled with tick marks at intervals of 2. The chart includes seven distinct lines: a purple line with triangle markers representing DiP, an orange line with triangle markers representing AnP, a blue line with triangle markers representing CoT, a black dashed line with square markers representing Dynamic w/ Oracle, a cyan line with triangle markers representing L2M, a light orange line with triangle markers representing SBP, and a red dotted line with circle markers representing Adaptive + Dynamic w/ Oracle. The DiP line starts at approximately 79.0 and rises to about 83.0 before slightly declining. The AnP line begins at 74.0, rises to a peak of about 79.0 at sampling time 5, then fluctuates with a slight downward trend to around 78.5. The CoT line starts at 80.0, rises to approximately 83.5, and then shows minor fluctuations before stabilizing near 83.0. The Dynamic w/ Oracle line begins at 89.0, dips slightly to 86.0, and then remains relatively flat around 87.0. The L2M line starts at 77.0, increases to about 81.5, and then fluctuates with a slight upward trend to around 82.0. The SBP line begins at 75.0, rises to approximately 81.0, and then fluctuates with a slight downward trend to around 80.0. The Adaptive + Dynamic w/ Oracle line starts at 89.0, remains nearly constant at approximately 89.5, and stays flat throughout the sampling time range.
